_doc: c08 (critic A #1): early fills for legato targets whose samples sag 5-12 dB for their first 0.3 s at a flat CC11. {track: {score onset qn: dB}}: vol_db ramps 0 at onset - 0.02 qn to +dB at onset + 0.05 s, holds to + 0.35 s, back to 0 by + 0.6 s. Value = measured sag - 2, capped at 8. c09 (A #1): Ob1 55.5/57/271, CA 99/129.5/133.5, Fl1 190/252 added and Fl1 256 3 -> 5 (transition-sample holes of 8-10 dB at 1-2 semitone slurred steps, dB = pre-envelope dip - 3). c10 (A #2, A #4): a value may be {"db", "pre_s"}: 0 at onset - pre_s - 0.03 s, +db at onset - pre_s, held to onset + 0.10 s, 0 by + 0.35 s (holes that start before the score onset); its breakpoints are written exactly (parts.json vol_bp). Cl1 266, Fl1 270.5, Hn1 203 (pre_s), BCl 92.5, Ob1 270/142, CA 132, CA 133.5 4 -> 6; strings Vla 244/245.5/254.5, Vln II 59/60, Vc 77/86, Vln I 67.5. c11 (A #2, C #2): a dict value may carry "hold_s" (default 0.10): +db held to onset + hold_s, 0 by onset + hold_s + 0.25 s (holes longer than 0.10 s); pre_s defaults to 0. Bn1 231/262/269, Hn1 203 hold, Vln I 71/80/86, Vln II 65/66, CA 129.5/168, Ob1 142.5, Cl1 184/186, Vla 251.5; Horn 3 204 and Horn 2 210 (slow Ab4 Sus MAX attacks). After the c11 render: Horn 3 204 8 -> {8, hold 0.10} and Horn 2 210 6 -> {5, hold 0.22} (the plain 0.35 s hold put both 4-10 dB over their body at +0.3..+0.45 s, where the samples swell by themselves); applied to the rendered stems as a post-render envelope fix.
